form.label: AD Account Activity & Threat Detection
form.description: Day-to-day Active Directory administration activity (account creation/deletion/disable, password resets, lockouts, privileged group changes) and detections of common attack techniques: password spray, Kerberoasting, DCSync, audit log clearing, audit policy tampering, DSRM and SID History changes. Based on Windows Security events from the domain controllers.

panel.title: Account lifecycle and credential events over time

search.query: `adx_security_events` `adx_normalize` | search event_id IN (4720,4722,4723,4724,4725,4726,4738,4740,4767,4781) | lookup adx_event_catalog event_id OUTPUT action | timechart count by action

`adx_security_events` `adx_normalize` | search is_group_event=1 | where match(group_name,"(?i)^(`adx_priv_group_names`)(?![\w -])") | lookup adx_event_catalog event_id OUTPUT action | rename actor_user as changed_by, target_user as member | sort - _time | table _time action group_name member changed_by dc

html.p: Audit log cleared (1102), audit policy changed (4719), DSRM password set (4794), SID History added (4765/4766).

search.query: `adx_security_events` `adx_normalize` | search event_id IN (1102,4719,4794,4765,4766) | lookup adx_event_catalog event_id OUTPUT action severity | sort - _time | table _time action severity actor_user target_user dc
`adx_security_events` `adx_normalize` | search event_id=4724 | stats count, dc(target_user) as accounts, latest(_time) as last by actor_user | eval last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - count

panel.title: Account lockouts - top accounts and callers

search.query: `adx_security_events` `adx_normalize` | search event_id=4740 | stats count, values(src_host) as caller_computers, latest(_time) as last by target_user | eval last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - count

`adx_security_events` `adx_normalize` | search event_id IN (4720,4726,4725) | lookup adx_event_catalog event_id OUTPUT action | rename actor_user as by_admin | sort - _time | table _time action target_user by_admin dc

html.p: One source failing against many distinct accounts (threshold: macro adx_spray_threshold).

search.query: `adx_security_events` (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4771 OR (EventCode=4776 NOT Error_Code=0x0)) `adx_normalize` | stats count as attempts, dc(target_user) as accounts, min(_time) as first, max(_time) as last, values(target_user) as sample by src_ip src_host | where accounts>=`adx_spray_threshold` | eval sample=mvindex(sample,0,4), first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - accounts
`adx_security_events` EventCode=4625 | eval code=coalesce(Sub_Status, SubStatus, Status) | lookup adx_failure_codes code OUTPUT reason | stats count by code reason | sort - count

panel.title: Kerberoasting suspects (RC4 service tickets for many SPNs)

search.query: `adx_security_events` EventCode=4769 `adx_normalize` | eval enc=coalesce(TicketEncryptionType, Ticket_Encryption_Type), svc=coalesce(ServiceName, Service_Name) | where enc="0x17" AND lower(svc)!="krbtgt" AND substr(svc,-1)!="$$" | stats dc(svc) as spns, count, values(svc) as sample by target_user src_ip | where spns>=5 | eval sample=mvindex(sample,0,4) | sort - spns

panel.title: DCSync suspects (directory replication rights used by a non-DC account)

html.p: Requires "Audit Directory Service Access" and SACL on the domain root; machine accounts (DC$) are excluded.

search.query: `adx_security_events` EventCode=4662 ("1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" OR "1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" OR "89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c") `adx_normalize` | where substr(actor_user,-1)!="$$" | stats count, latest(_time) as last by actor_user dc | eval last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
